title: Autonomy Register — Section A: System Identity
description: Section A of the Autonomy Register entry, as specified in STD-EDS-007.

system_id.description: Format: SYS-YYYY-NNN. Unique across all entries including retired. Immutable after assignment. (Source of truth: CAIO office)

system_name.description: Human-readable. Unique across all active entries. No special characters except hyphens and spaces. (Source of truth: System owner)

system_owner.description: Must reference a current employee. Cannot be the CAIO office or AI QA Function. Owner and accountable-role fields are validated against the live HR system at routing time, not only at registration. A role reference that resolves to a departed or rotated holder whose directory entry has not yet been updated is treated identically to a vacant role: the flag faults rather than routing to a stale holder, and the fault is escalated under POL-EDS-003. Absence of a current HR-confirmed holder is a rout

cto_technical_lead.description: Must reference a current employee in the CTO organisation. (Source of truth: CTO)

accountable_executive.description: Must reference a current employee. Must match the accountable human executive named in the current MDAM entry for every domain in operational_domains. Validated against the live HR system at routing time; a reference resolving to a departed or rotated holder is a routing fault under POL-EDS-003, not a silent assignment. (Source of truth: CAIO office — validated against MDAM)

statutory_accountable_person.description: The individual assigned accountability for the relevant area of responsibility under the applicable statutory accountability regime, or under formal Board or CEO delegation where none applies. Must equal accountable_executive unless statutory_binding_status is ‘Divergence Approved’. (Source of truth: General Counsel — sourced from the entity's statutory accountability records)

statutory_accountability_ref.description: Reference and version or effective date of the record from which the statutory assignment is drawn. (Source of truth: General Counsel)

statutory_binding_status.description: Values: Reconciled │ Divergence Approved │ Divergence Unapproved. ‘Divergence Approved’ requires a BRC approval reference in approved_exception_refs. ‘Divergence Unapproved’ blocks deployment; an active system in this state must be suspended within 5 business days. (Source of truth: CAIO office — confirmed at each quarterly reconciliation)

accountability_acceptance_ref.description: [Mandatory before activation] Format: AAR-YYYY-NNN. Must reference a signed Accountability Acceptance Record whose signing executive equals accountable_executive. Null permitted only where current_status is ‘Pending Deployment’. (Source of truth: CAIO office)

description.description: Plain language. Must not contain system_id or technical jargon as the primary content. (Source of truth: System owner)

operational_domains.description: Each domain must match an approved MDAM domain entry. Minimum one domain. (Source of truth: CAIO office — validated against MDAM)

production_deployment_date.description: [Mandatory on activation] Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Null for Pending Deployment status. (Source of truth: CAIO office)

current_status.description: Values: Active │ Suspended │ Pending Deployment │ Retired. Default: Pending Deployment on creation. (Source of truth: CAIO office)
